course: I found the course readings to be particularly challenging in both length and level of difficulty. On a weekly basis, we were expected to read two to three articles of over 20 pages each and come prepared to actively participate in discussion sessions, which together accounted for 25% of the overall course grade. Many of the readings were written using dense theoretical language and heavy terminology, making them difficult to understand without extensive background knowledge. Including more introductory readings, especially earlier in the course, would have helped students better engage with the material and participate more confidently in discussions.
